title: Certified ER component-level causal ablation
type: diagnostic / causal ablation; error localization, not fidelity improvement
classification: suffix batch of the WL104 line (dependent evidence-gap follow-up of WL104B-G; no new mechanism, no training)
repository: kn99e39/ReST-GI (origin URL kn99e39/NeuralShaderDemo resolves to the same repository)
host: local RTX 5080 (WL104E-G precedent: owner directed rendering to the local machine; inputs are local)

frozen_inputs.authentication: Every input file is checked against the sha256 recorded by the WL104G manifest (evaluation/104G/manifest.json: frozen_WL104F_input_sha256, frozen_WL104G_fit_input_sha256, raw_sha256 relative to results/ecro_wl84_104g/). Any mismatch stops the run.
frozen_inputs.angular_reference: results/ecro_wl84_104d/amendment1/amended_reference.npz (WL104D Amendment 1 independent layered reference: 9 materials x 10 polar x 2 azimuth probes, 1024 directional lanes, two independent walk halves, dense peak grid of 257 directions per probe)
frozen_inputs.raw_states: R0 raw z from results/fnto_compiled83/results/fit/fit_<set>_ER_cert_metric_12000_generic.npz; A and C raw z from evaluation/104D/fit_states.npz. compile(raw) must equal the archived compiled state (atol 2e-6, rtol 1e-5).

test83_iid_1_L2.inputs: results/ecro_wl84_104g/scenes/test83_iid_1_L2 (reference, R0 per replicate; masks incl. WL104A interaction ROIs) and results/ecro_wl84_104e/parent/scenes/test83_iid_1_L2 (archived native A, C)

invariants: No learned parameter, compiled state, sampling probability, proposal, geometry, camera, light, mask, reference or threshold is changed.
No shared renderer / closure file is modified; all instrumentation is experiment-local (experiments/ecro_wl84_104h).
Counterfactuals are diagnostic evaluations only; none is a correction candidate, none is adopted.

decomposition.native: F = O0 + O1 + O2 + S (L + I0 + I1 + I2 + I3), S = s(mu_i) s(mu_o); cosine-weighted response F = f cos(theta_o), wi camera/view side, shading frame

terms.O_k: lam[c, 1+k] g_k(wi, wo) cos_o, outer GGX lobe k = 0..2 (anisotropic GGX, Schlick F0_k, horizon-safe WL81 form)
terms.I_k: lam[c, 4+k] g_{3+k}(t(wi), t(wo)) cos_o / eta^2, inner refracted GGX lobe k = 0..3, t(w) = (w_x/eta, w_y/eta, sqrt(max(eta^2-1,0)+w_z^2)/eta)
terms.U_k: lam[c, 4+k] g_{3+k}(wi, wo) cos_o (inner lobe without the refracted mapping; used only by ETA_OFF / ETA_ATTEN_OFF)
terms.s: s_c(mu) piecewise-linear through 15 knots (3 channels x mu 0, .15, .4, .7, 1), values in [0, 1]

decomposition.parameter_ownership: 64 raw parameters: z[3k], z[3k+1] log-alpha_u / log-alpha_v logits and z[3k+2] F0 logit of GGX lobe k (k 0..2 outer, 3..6 inner); z[21+9c+r] softmax logit of slot r (0 Lambert, 1..3 outer, 4..7 inner, 8 absorption) per channel c; z[48+5c+j] attenuation knot; z[63] eta logit (eta = 1 + 1.5 sigmoid). Sampling probabilities (8 compiled floats) derive from lam and F0 at compile time and belong to the proposal; they are never perturbed. Torch (closure82 + closure83 patch) and Dr.Jit (closure83_dr) share this ownership; differences: float64 vs float32 and evaluation order only.

identity_tolerances.torch_vs_drjit_note: float32 runtime vs float64; worst case in development = refracted inner lobes at grazing pairs with eta ~ 1.0002 (float32 cancellation in eta^2 - 1), 2-4e-5 of the term peak

interventions.validity: VALID_FAMILY = lam = 0, knots = 1 or eta = 1 inside the certified ER family (reciprocal, passive by the WL82 certificate); each VALID_FAMILY intervention is cross-checked against the native evaluator with the equivalently modified 69-float state. DIAGNOSTIC_ONLY = breaks reciprocity; albedo-matched variants are all DIAGNOSTIC_ONLY.

interaction_diagnostics.ATTEN_INTERACTION: Delta(ATTEN_OFF) - Delta(ATTEN_IN_OFF) - Delta(ATTEN_OUT_OFF) = (1-s_i)(1-s_o)(L + sum I) (multiplicative factorization)
interaction_diagnostics.ETA_ATTEN_INTERACTION: Delta(ETA_ATTEN_OFF) - Delta(ETA_OFF) - Delta(ATTEN_OFF) = (1-S)(sum U - sum I) (shared attenuation of the inner group)
interaction_diagnostics.additive: Interactions of additive term removals under frozen directions are algebraically zero and are not reported as findings.

response_phase.lanes: all 9 materials x 20 probes x 1024 lanes of the amended reference, weights w = use / q (rejected proposal lanes w = 0)
response_phase.evaluator: Dr.Jit runtime terms (float32 compiled state) for the response statistics; Torch float64 for identity and parameter analysis
response_phase.probe_inner_product: <f, g>_p = sum_l w_l sum_c f_lc g_lc / A_p^2, A_p = sum_l w_l sum_c ref_lc (WL82 el1 normaliser), ref = (a + b) / 2
response_phase.residual: r = ref - F_R0; noise-unbiased |r|^2 = <a - F_R0, b - F_R0>; reference noise energy nu = |a - b|^2 / 4

statistics.rho: cross / sqrt(n2 |r|^2) (alignment of the intervention change with the residual; signed: + component in excess where residual is negative)
statistics.error_change: e_X = (2 cross - n2) / |r|^2 = fraction of residual energy removed by the full-strength intervention (negative = error grows)
statistics.l1: el1 change per reference half (WL82 metric), sign agreement across halves
statistics.energy: signed luma energy change per region / reference luma energy
statistics.matched: albedo-matched F~_X = F_X * a_R0,c / a_X,c per probe and channel (a = sum_l w F); qualified only if a_X,c >= 0.01 a_R0,c for every channel; DIAGNOSTIC_ONLY; shape fraction = |F~_X - F_R0| / |Delta F_X|

response_phase.aggregation: Stratum sums of per-probe normalised quantities (equal weight per probe), ratios of sums.
response_phase.uncertainty: Delete-one-block jackknife over 16 interleaved lane blocks (lane index mod 16) applied simultaneously to every probe; 95% t interval, 15 dof.
response_phase.peak_grid: Per probe: reference peak = max luma of the half mean over 257 dense directions; R0, each term and each intervention evaluated at the same directions; relative peak error and term shares at the reference peak and at the exact mirror direction (descriptive).
response_phase.training_support_note: Probes 57.5/60/62.5 deg lie in the WL81/WL83 training-incidence gap (WL104C) for R0; the independent reference qualified there (WL104D A1 / WL104G). Band results are labelled as training-support-absent for R0, not as reference deficiency.
response_phase.c_minus_a: Delta_CA = F_C - F_A exactly decomposed: outer O_k^C - O_k^A; attenuation (S_C - S_A)(Y_A + Y_C)/2 and content (S_A + S_C)/2 (Y_C - Y_A) for Y in {L, I_k} (two-factor symmetric split, exact). Shares = <part, Delta_CA> / |Delta_CA|^2 (sum 1). Each R0 intervention change is also projected on Delta_CA.

parameter_phase.method: Exact forward-mode derivatives (torch.func.jacfwd) of the Torch float64 closure at the frozen raw state (R0 per material), on all response lanes; rows weighted sqrt(w_l) / A_p. No optimizer, no step, no new state.
parameter_phase.fd_check: Central differences h = 1e-4 on every raw coordinate for the 3 development materials; error per column = |FD - AD| / max(|AD column|, 1e-4 max column norm) (floor avoids roundoff-dominated ratios on columns ~1e-7 of the max); pass if max <= 1e-6. Development probe: h 1e-5 gave 9.8e-6 on a column of 6e-7 relative norm (roundoff), h 1e-3 gave 8e-7 (truncation).
parameter_phase.groups: orthonormal raw-space groups: amplitude (27 logits incl. absorption slot), roughness ((z_u + z_v)/sqrt 2 per lobe, 7), anisotropy ((z_u - z_v)/sqrt 2 per lobe, 7), fresnel (7), attenuation (15), eta (1); per-lobe sub-blocks for amplitude/roughness/anisotropy/fresnel
parameter_phase.projection: Orthogonal projector onto the group column space from an SVD with relative rcond 1e-10. First-order explainable residual fraction R2_g = <P_g r_a, r_b> / <r_a, r_b> (noise-unbiased cross-half); unique R2_g = R2_all - R2_(all without g).
parameter_phase.rank_report: singular values in raw units; weak if sigma / sigma_max < 1e-3, null if < 1e-6 (the 3 softmax shift directions are algebraic nulls and are not reported as findings)
parameter_phase.coupling: principal-angle cosines between group column spaces; |cos| >= 0.99 = locally non-identifiable pair of directions
parameter_phase.uncertainty: same 16-block lane jackknife (projector recomputed per replicate)
parameter_phase.c_minus_a: integrated gradients along the straight raw path z_A -> z_C, 32-point Gauss-Legendre; completeness residual reported; group shares projected on Delta_CA
parameter_phase.scope: local linear (Gauss-Newton tangent-space) analysis only; not a capacity bound

scene_phase.tracer: WL104E/F/G camera tracer (pt102 adapter, WL81 camera, one point light, spot cone); archived launch layout (512 spp per launch, seed*1000003 + launch) replayed exactly with sub-chunks via PCG32 initseq offsets
scene_phase.E1: every term evaluated at the fixed point-light direction at the first hit on sphere/cube, times light rgb / d^2 and visibility
scene_phase.E2: common frozen native R0 proposal at the first hit; every term divided by the same actual R0 pdf; fixed R0 terminal response, visibility and geometry at hit 2; rejected draws contribute zero to every term
scene_phase.unchanged: non-ER first hits (native), HIGH (archived R0), proposal, terminal
scene_phase.images: per event: R0 terms O0..O2, S L, S I0..I3, (L + sum I), s_o (L + sum I), s_i (L + sum I), S sum U, (L + sum U); A and C: O_k, S_X Y_X and the cross products S_A Y_C, S_C Y_A for Y in L, I0..I3; plus the non-ER native images
scene_phase.identity: R0 native image = N + term sum must equal the archived R0 E1 / E2 per replicate (relative L1 <= 2e-5); A / C term sums must equal archived native A / C E1 on the development scenes; lane-level native-eval vs term-sum and w * pdf vs eval residuals <= 2e-6 of peak
scene_phase.statistics: per event (E1, E2, E1+E2): cross-replicate unbiased inner products (stats104b.ms_loo) of Delta E_X with the absolute residual R = ref - R0, with Delta E_X itself, and with the C - A change (A, C evaluated with the same R0 proposal); rho, error_change and stable RMS change as in the response phase; signed energy change; delete-one-replicate jackknife (12 replicates, 11 dof)
scene_phase.c_minus_a_check: projection of the fixed-R0-proposal C - A E2 change on the archived native CC - AA E2 change (proposal independence, WL104F)
scene_phase.no_total_claim: E1 + E2 with archived R0 HIGH is a diagnostic response-only counterfactual; no production TOTAL fidelity is inferred

labels.EVIDENCE_UNQUALIFIED: reference precision gate fails for the stratum, or |r|^2 jackknife lower bound <= 0 (residual not resolved), or (matched variant) a normalisation is unqualified in any probe of the stratum
labels.NO_DETECTABLE_COMPONENT_EFFECT: n2 < 9 nu (change below 3 sigma of reference noise; response phase only) or the 95% interval of the error change includes 0
labels.CONDITIONAL_ERROR_LOCALIZATION: detectable, |rho| 95% interval entirely beyond 0.5 with fixed sign, and (response) the same holds per material in at least 2 of 3 development or 4 of 6 held-out materials of the cohort, and no intervention of a different family both reaches the same rule and has |cos(Delta F_X, Delta F_Y)| >= 0.9
labels.CONFOUNDED_OR_NON_IDENTIFIABLE: localisation rule met but an intervention of a different family with |cos| >= 0.9 also meets it
labels.within_family: nested interventions (group vs its lobes) are reported as hierarchical shares <Delta lobe, Delta group> / |Delta group|^2, not as confounding
labels.scene: same rules on each scene x event x ROI separately (development and held-out reported separately), detectability = error-change interval excludes 0 and |Delta E|^2 lower bound > 0

focused_tests: reciprocity of VALID_FAMILY / non-reciprocity of DIAGNOSTIC_ONLY
scene: frozen proposal / pdf identity, E1 and E2 counterfactual consistency vs native, deterministic replay, sub-chunk replay of the archived launch layout
stops: scene replay of the archived R0 fails (proposal or geometry changed)
analysis would require changing the certified representation
